bullets.text: OnePlus 15 Launches in China - **OnePlus 15** is now available in China, with a global launch expected soon.
Apple's App Store Monopoly Case - A UK tribunal rules against **Apple**, potentially costing the company $2 billion.
Spotify Revamps Apple TV App - **Spotify** introduces a new Apple TV app with video podcasts and music videos.
UK Regulator Targets Apple and Google - The **CMA** designates **Apple** and **Google** as having strategic market status.
Waymo Expands Robotaxi Operations - **Waymo** plans to launch in more U.S. cities and London by 2026.
Fitbit's New AI Health Coach - **Fitbit** rolls out a Gemini-powered health coach to Premium users.
